variants.title: Shot noise of a vacuum photodiode (nanoamp currents)
variants.sample: Vacuum photodiode, photocurrents up to 2 microamperes, 100 megohm feedback
variants.note: A vacuum photodiode gives microamp photocurrents, so the amplifier needs a 100 megohm feedback resistor and a narrower 2 kHz band. The seven currents are a thousand times smaller than in the base experiment.
